title: Fats Waller's piano sound and the Atlantic City restaurant feast
summary: Thomas praises Waller's piano sound, then recounts Fats ordering three chickens and three steaks at a restaurant and the waitress setting the table for four, to which Fats replied that no one else was coming.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
